newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies close mixed, marks, Swiss francs up.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies close mixed, marks, Swiss francs up.

text.p: Jan 29 - IMM currency futures closed mixed, with marks and Swiss francs ending higher. However, many traders said the upside for both contracts was limited. They said strength in U.S. stocks would keep the U.S. dollar firm. March yen finished near the daily low and Can dollars were off all day.
